integrity: Analytical proof with standalone finite arithmetic and orbit checker; numerical checks do not certify universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic model at b=1, a,p,q,alpha>0, y0,z0>0. Initial-state constant finite but not given in closed form. No conclusions for b!=1 or stochastic forcing. Historical novelty assessed with accessible primary sources and index; independent validation not performed.
title: Global critical extinction with a cancellable logarithmic clock in an exponential predator-prey map
